C0915.title: Jinshi Police Crack Massive "Money-Muling Platform" Case with 5 Billion Yuan in Transactions
C0915.summary: In November 2021, the Public Security Bureau of Jinshi City, Hunan Province, successfully dismantled a large-scale online "money-muling platform" operation. The criminal syndicate provided illegal fund settlement services for underground industries such as online gambling through the platform, with total transaction flows reaching 5 billion yuan.
